plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Fix multiple Node worker processes accumulating on restart. Fix ffmpeg path inconsistency - all ffmpeg calls now respect the path override. Add proxy log file (BIN_DIR/ytmproxy.log) with configurable path in settings. piCorePlayer users can set path to /var/log/pcp_ytmproxy.log. Thanks to Paul Webster.
plugin.creator: schmij97
